newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Tower says fund returns strong in Sept year.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Tower says fund returns strong in Sept year.

text.p: Tower Retirement Investment's retail diversified funds returned strong after-tax results for the year to September 1996, managing director Stuart Fish said on Wednesday.

Tower's Balanced, Growth and Capital Protected funds returned 5.5 percent, 7.1 percent and 5.0 percent respectively after tax and management fees for the year to September. "Our stable of personal retirement funds recently reached a milestone with funds under management breaking the $600 million mark," Fish said in a statement.
Of the single asset class funds, the NZ Companies fund was the best performer, returning 10.3 percent after tax and management fees in the September year.

Fish said Tower Portfolio Management had done well to outperform the strong returns of domestic markets in the September quarter which more than reversed the poor market returns of the previous three months.
